name: Darkness
description: You can only see what's close.
_help: lightRadius in pixels. darkness: 1 = pitch black, 0 = no effect. glow: things drawn on top of the dark so they stay visible (platformer: coins, flag, spikes, enemies; shmup: coins, enemyShots, enemies; brawler: coins, flag, rocks, windups, enemies; racer: coins, flag, windups, enemies). Brawler "windups": an enemy about to attack lights up, so every hit can be seen coming. Racer: beam is how far your headlight reaches ahead of the bike (the light around you is lightRadius).
